# Kenney Particle Pack (1.1)

- Source: https://kenney.nl/assets/particle-pack
- Author: Kenney Vleugels / Kenney.nl
- License: Creative Commons Zero (CC0), including commercial use. Original License.txt preserved.
- Original download: kenney_particle-pack.zip; unmodified originals in original/.
- Runtime selection: dirt_01, dirt_02, smoke_01, smoke_04, dirt_03, trace_01 (transparent PNGs).
- Unity: Book/Assets/Unfin/Resources/Effects/Kenney; PaperVfx uses standard alpha, muted taupe RGB 0.64/0.60/0.52, opacity 0.26–0.52. No additive glow.
- Events: enemy hit, player active attack, ground/air dash, jump/wall jump, landing, running and wall movement dust. Existing attack silhouette and hit range retained. No hurt animation added.
- Pool: 128 sprites, 0.12–0.4 seconds lifetime, cleared on respawn. Effects do not alter gameplay timing or damage.
